# Getting help

- **Questions and ideas:** open a [discussion](https://github.com/w0h1v/mcp-proton/discussions) (if enabled) or an issue using the feature request template.
- **Bugs:** use the bug report template and attach `mcp-proton diagnostics --json` output. It contains metadata only. Never paste message contents, mailbox exports, passwords or tokens.
- **Bridge behaves differently than documented:** use the compatibility report template, ideally with `mcp-proton probe` output from a dedicated test account.
- **Security vulnerabilities:** report privately via [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/w0h1v/mcp-proton/security/advisories/new). See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
- **Proton account, billing or Bridge problems:** contact [Proton support](https://proton.me/support). This project is independent of Proton AG and cannot fix them.
